text_block_list.text:
The Spring Fan Thanksgiving has arrived!
While the athletic competitions are heating up, Curren Chan on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone, I'm taking the photo~.
The magic word is~... cheese♪

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fans
text_block_list.text: Cute Curren Chaaaaaaaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, looking good♪

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much~~!!
I'm gonna enlarge it to full poster size
and hang it in the nicest spot in my house!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren will be so happy if you take good care of it♪
Please keep supporting me, okay!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fans
text_block_list.text: Of course~~~~!!

"...As for Curren Chan,
she was busy doing fan service as usual."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, Big Brother!
choice_data_list: You really are super popular, huh.
You really are super popular, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, big sis!
choice_data_list: You really are super popular, huh.
You really are super popular, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, you're only noticing now~?
Curren's always been like this, hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, or maybe...
did you get lonely from being left alone?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You can be pretty cute yourself, Big Brother♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You know, you have such a cute side to you♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Though after this, I might not be able
to give you much attention today.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren's scheduled to enter a lot more events after this...
and if the crowd grows, even more people will cheer for me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Because this is our chance!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So many people came today, after all.
I have to show off my charm and connect it to the "Cute Derby♪"♪
True to her word, Curren Chan bustled about energetically—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—"Charge Ahead! Muddy Dirt Showdown!"
The glorious winner, plunging through the mud without a moment's hesitation, is Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh no, it turned into mush~.

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Even covered in dirt, she's so cuuuuute! 
Such an unmistakable air of mystique!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I've been seeing that girl all over the place lately.
Huh, she's got some real guts.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~... Hey, Big Brother,
all the mud came off, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~... Hey, Big Sister,
all the mud came off, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mm, glad to hear it.
Well then, let's take a short break—

text_block_list.name: Foreign Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! Curren Chan!
Found you!"

text_block_list.name: Foreign Reporter
text_block_list.text:
We are a television production crew from abroad.
Would you happen to have a moment to spare?

text_block_list.name: Foreign Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Please allow us to interview you about the "Kawaii Derby♪"
that's creating quite a buzz around here right now!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, of course♪
Feel free to ask me anything!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"—Well then, I'll be back to interview you again
around the Sprinters Stakes! Kawaii Curren Chan!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you so much~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Yup, I'm good!
It's such a surprise having someone come all the way from overseas for an interview~."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
People all over the world are enjoying
the “Cute Derby♪” too, huh...
......

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I need to start thinking about the next event.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Just take a look around us, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Just take a look around us, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa, Daiwa Scarlet-san!
Vodka-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Kya! Look, look, Dober-san and the Vice President,
they look so cool just standing there...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "...Curren draws attention too, but at a Fan Appreciation Day packed with popular girls, she might get buried."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I need one more push...
I have to enter an event where Curren can really stand out...

...Curren Chan is deep in thought. She seemseven more conscious of the surrounding gazes than usual.
And what she chose was—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: “—And the Scavenger Hunt is nearing its end! The first one dashing into the goal is...!”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪
Curren is number one!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: “Task: Go to the special booth, change into your school uniform, and return! And Curren Chan does it in a mind-blowing 1 minute and 6 seconds!!”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for your support—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaah...! Cute, cute Curren-chaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "...Maybe choosing the 'scavenger hunt' was a bit of a mistake."
choice_data_list: It was getting so exciting, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It was definitely a blast,
but completely within Curren's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "The scavenger hunt is a popular event, so I was planning to put on a bit of a performance and hype it up more."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm,
maybe the choice lacked an element of surprise...

Curren Chan sank into thought...
However, it seems she found a hint for the future.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Curren is entering the Long-Distance Marathon!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know, Onii-chan.
You're wondering if Curren can really
make it through a long distance, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know, Onee-chan.
You're wondering if Curren can really
make it through a long distance, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"That gap is what makes it so great, right?
I'm sure everyone will take notice."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "If we win... don't you think we'll get an incredible reaction?"
"It's true that *if she wins*, it would make big news. However, there will surely be Umamusume specialized in long distances running in the marathon."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I'll be fine! Curren has run
a whole lot with Onii-chan, after all!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I'll be fine! Curren has run
a whole lot with Onee-chan, after all!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So I don't plan on just coasting on the contrast.
I'm running to win, you know!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The long-distance marathon is finally reaching its climax!
The first one charging toward the finish line is...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Mm, thank you...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I ended up losing in the end.
Ahaha, pretty uncool of me after talking so big, huh?”
Proof of that being—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chaaan! Great job out there!
You gave it your all till the very end!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
She's actually a sprinter, right?
I think I'll go look up how she runs.
choice_data_list: Everyone is watching you after running all the way through.
Everyone is watching you after running all the way through.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha♪
Then it's a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
A loss is a loss, Curren isn't cute at all right now.
Even so... I'm glad they could feel how serious I was.
choice_data_list: Is this situation part of the plan too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But... Big Brother taught Curren that trying your hardest is the cutest look!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But... Big Sister taught Curren that trying your hardest is the cutest look!

Facing an uphill battle, she genuinely aimed for victory,
and gave it her all even in defeat. The applause directed at her
didn't die down for quite some time...
